And the way he explains it there is that we can look at people when we're judging in two ways: we can look at them as an other, where we don't relate to them and don't empathize with them, or we can look at them from a closer perspective as, you know, as so that we can relate to them, and then we look at them with more חסד, with more empathy. And so it says that's the idea that before destroying סדום, you know, השם wanted to come down and see it from a closer perspective and see if you could find a זכות if it was... And I think in in the פשט that was like the מלאכים first spoke to לוט and they and they waited to see if לוט could learn a זכות for them, because אברהם was like from afar and he didn't relate to them, but לוט was actually living there. And but even when they saw, like רש״י says, when they saw that even לוט couldn't, you know, be מלמד זכות, all night he was trying to to argue for their merit, and when, you know, they did what they did, he said, you know, they surrounded the house and they attacked them, and they said, "You're going to still defend them?" and he couldn't defend them. And so I think, you know, this is an idea that sometimes the same like in תורה there are certain things where it says you have to do this, you're not allowed to do that, you could you could have the same words and the same message, but it could be with a קול of kindness and understanding, where you recognize, or it could be like in a very harsh, judgmental way. And that changes the whole thing. So just like in general in life, in תורה it's the same thing: it should be with a קול of חסד, usually, right? Okay. So, והוא בחינת יחוד יעקב ורחל, and so this idea of expressing our feelings in our words together with the voice, that's called the union of יעקב and רחל. That's the metaphor for it, is that when I'm speaking, there I'm sharing certain words, but I'm also putting my emotional state into it. דהיינו, so יעקב is the emotions, the feelings, and רחל is the speech. דהיינו בחינת המשכה של המדות שבלב הבא בבחינת רוח הבל הלב מורכב מאש מים רוח רוחניים עד בחינת קול הדיבור. And this is the idea that the spiritual the the מדות of the heart, the emotions, are coming into this spiritual רוח הבל הלב, which is made up of אש מים רוח of the the three parts of the גבורה, חסד, and and the ממוצע between the two, רחמים. And then and that finally comes into the actual voice, the physical voice. ובחינת כח הדיבור נמשך מנקבי החזה דריאה וכו׳ ונקרא רוח ממללא. And then the actual power to speak speak comes out from the the trachea, right, the the pipe, the windpipe, which connects the lungs to the mouth so that you can actually speak. And that's what's called the רוח ממללא, the spirit, the the translation of אונקלוס that man was given a a living soul, right, a נפש... is that God put gave us a רוח ממללא, speaking, translated as a speaking soul. So, this the idea that we have this ability to speak and express ourself. So, this is the first thing. So, the משל for this is again like we talked about how a person speaks and we see this every single day that, you know, learning and, you know, part of it is just a natural thing like a baby even before they can speak, they cry and they have that קול and you can hear also animals. You can hear how they're feeling in their voice even though they can't speak. But then there's the idea that that gets expressed into the actual words and, you know, there's a certain thing that you could learn like a singer or an actor or a good speaker, right, they learn how to put certain things into their voice to affect the people and, you know, so it can be both ways. So, that's the משל. Then there's idea of how that relates to תורה like we were talking about that there's the simple thing is that, you know, the understanding of the הלכות of the תורה of whether something is אסור or מותר and things like that, that's the מדות. And then that gets expressed as the actual הלכה פסוקה which is the the תורה שבכתב, תורה שבעל פה, and that's the the actual דבור. And this is what it says that the כתר of נוקבא is in the the the lungs of זעיר אנפין, like we said, because a person's desire to speak depends on how they're feeling. So, there's this constant connection of how Godliness is being expressed both in creating the physical world and in the תורה that is always connected to these these inner מדות. כמו שמבואר במקום אחר, as explained elsewhere, בענין ממצוא חפצך ודבר דבר. It says if you find your desire and speak some words, right, in other words, that when a person has you have to have this motivation to speak. מקור כח הדבור שנמשך מהבל הלב, and this is the source of the power to speak that comes from the הבל הלב דזעיר אנפין, וכנראה בחוש, you see tangibly, שאם הלב עצב בכיווץ ימעט בדיבור, that if a person is sad, right, they're sad or depressed, then they're going to the heart is withdrawn and they're going to not speak a lot. וכשהוא בהתפשטות, when a person feels very expansive, they feel happy and things like that, ירחיב הדיבור, they're going to talk a lot. לפי שכח של הדיבור תלוי בהבל הקול שבלב עצמו, because the power to speak depends on that הבל in the קול itself.
